Duchesne County, Utah
New Drug Charges For Man Arrested On Warrant
By Basin Now,
1 days agoA man was arrested in Duchesne County on September 22nd after an officer recognized him as one with an active no-bail warrant out for his arrest. According to the Affidavit of Probable Cause, the officer observed the man traveling in Ballard City until stopping in a trailer park. The officer placed 56-year-old Phillip T. Garcia under arrest for the warrant. A plastic baggie of Methamphetamine was located in Garcia’s front pocket and a Meth pipe was located in the door of the vehicle. A second baggie with white substance consistent with Methamphetamine was located between the driver’s seat and console and an open bottle of rum was behind the passenger seat. Garcia was brought into custody and is also facing new felony drug charges as well as Misdemeanor Driving on a Denied License and Open Container in a Vehicle.
